content:
The official 2026 Amazon Black Friday sale is now live with a solid $70 off AirPods Pro 3 and the lowest prices ever on Apple Watch Series 12, among many other Apple deals, but we are now tracking some of the very best MacBook deals of the year. We are catching a surprising and super rare $50 price drop on MacBook Neo from $649 as well as $250 discounts across the entire M5 MacBook Air lineup (including the best price in months on the most affordable model), and the very first deals on the brand new M6 MacBook Pro and Apple’s new touchscreen PROLED MacBook Pro at up to $250 off.

MacBook Neo

Black Friday is delivering the very first significant price drops on the most affordable current-generation MacBook you can buy – MacBook Neo now starts from $649 with all colors across both configurations now marked down:

  • MacBook Neo 256GB $650 (Reg. $700)
  • MacBook Neo 512GB $750 (Reg. $800)

M5 MacBook Air

We caught some $250 discounts on the M5 MacBook Air lineup as part of the early Black Friday sales, but with the main event now in full swing the entire lineup on Amazon is now deeply discounts – this includes the most affordable model, which hasn’t dropped this low since the official price increases way back in June:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,049 (Reg. $1,299) – $250 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,349 (Reg. $1,599) – $250 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,799) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,249 (Reg. $1,499) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,799) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,749 (Reg. $1,999) – $250 off

M6 MacBook Pro

Black Friday Week at Amazon is ushering in the very first chances to save on the brand new M6 MacBook Pro, and we are talking about more than notable $150 price drops here on the 16GB, 24GB, and 32GB configurations:

  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (Reg. $1,999) – All-time low
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,049 (Reg. $2,199) – All-time low
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 32GB/1TB $2,249 (Reg. $2,399) – All-time low

M5 Pro MacBook Pro PROLED XDR

We didn’t expect to see significant price drops on the exciting new touchscreen MacBook, but even Apple’s new PROLED XDR display machines aren’t safe from Black Friday. As of right now, we are tracking up to $250 off the list prices on a few different configurations:

  • 16-inch PROLED XDR MacBook Pro with touch 24GB/1TB $3,249 (Reg. $3,399)
  • 16-inch PROLED XDR MacBook Pro with touch 48GB/1TB $3,799 (Reg. $3,999)
  • 16-inch PROLED XDR MacBook Pro with touch 32GB/2TB $4,549 (Reg. $4,799)

More of the best Black Friday Week Apple deals:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249) – Now even lower
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)
  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 42mm: $329 (Reg. $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $379 (Reg. $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm: $429 (Reg. $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $479 (Reg. $549)
  • Apple Pencil (USB-C) $69 (Reg. $79)
